output.encoding: PNG R8 linear UNorm; north-up file rows

ownership_semantics.code_0: Pixel is outside validated eligible canopy or Tier0-2 authored geometry owns it
ownership_semantics.code_255: Pixel is validated eligible canopy fully owned by the Tier3 canopy-map representation
ownership_semantics.combination: minimum quantized handoff value across all authored footprints

eligible_canopy_gate.linear_sampling_note: base-level R8 is sampled bilinearly; no mip chain can reintroduce excluded distant texels
eligible_canopy_gate.source: same decoded surface-features and DTM eligibility function used by the frozen distribution

ownership_semantics.tier0_tier1_footprint: conservative oriented rectangle from the source mesh horizontal AABB and authored transform
ownership_semantics.tier2_footprint: authored PCA ellipse; feather distance is outward radial distance along the center ray
ownership_semantics.tier3_spatial_domain: geometry complement inside the validated lidar square, not a beyond-4000m radial band

source_and_license.source: Deterministic project-authored derivative of the validated vegetation distribution and source bounds
